overview_description.description:
Galaxy is an online collaborative work environment that connects people and projects around the world. 

Galaxy features a unique dashboard that allows managers to see every group, user, and project from one screen. Users get up and running fast, allowing managers the ability to quickly create, task, and prioritize projects. Galaxy claims to save managers time, while in the process, empowering the elements of every project: the people.

Galaxy attempts to simplify project management through it's simple and effective screens and interactions.
